ValidationRule.description: This validation rule would take place when closure reason is 'have a better alternative'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $User.LastName <> "Integration" && ISPICKVAL(Type,'Credit Card Account Closing') && ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,'Credit Card Account Closing') && ISPICKVAL(Closure_Reason__c, 'Have a better alternative') && ISBLANK(Merchant_Name__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Merchant/Provider Name is mandatory for 'Have a better alternative' closure.
